Subject: Change of billing entity following acquisition

Hi Hannah,

Quick note from Pine Harbor accounting — we closed on the acquisition by Clearwater Holdings last week and need Redwood's help to migrate billing for our account. Effective 2026-09-01, invoices should be billed to Clearwater Holdings (new legal name) and remit to their treasury team.

What we can provide now: signed APA (attached), new tax ID (EIN: 12-3456789), and a new PO (PH-CLW-2026-007). We still have an outstanding invoice for August usage (INV-20260831-772) for $38,640 that needs to be collected.

Two asks:
- Can you reissue outstanding/open invoices to the new entity or instruct us on what information you need to accept payment from Clearwater?
- Is there a preferred process for credit memos / invoice reissuance so we don't double-pay during the SAP migration?

We are on a tight audit timeline and would appreciate a response this week.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Accounting Manager
Pine Harbor, Inc.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Change of billing entity following acquisition

Hi all — thanks for the attachments, Alicia. I reviewed the APA and the new Clearwater W-9 (please also send a copy of their ACH details if available). To proceed from our finance side we need the following to safely reissue invoices and accept payment without creating duplicate accounting lines: 

Required items (please provide as soon as possible):
- Signed APA (we have this)
- Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on invoices: "Clearwater Holdings, LLC"
- EIN / Tax ID (provided: 12-3456789)
- New billing address and remit-to address (street, city, zip)
- Confirmation of remit method: ACH (with account+routing), wire instructions, or the payment portal URL
- PO or reference for open invoices (PH-CLW-2026-007)

Recommended process (our standard for M&A cutovers):
1) We create a credit memo for the open invoice(s) issued to Pine Harbor and zero them out.
2) We reissue new invoices to Clearwater for the same amounts, referencing the new PO.
3) We include a short audit note on both sets of invoices explaining the legal-entity transition and link to the APA.

If you'd prefer instead that Clearwater simply pays the Pine Harbor invoice directly (no reissue), we can accept that provided the payment remitter is listed as Clearwater and we receive a signed remittance authorization. Note that for tax reporting we prefer invoices to match the paying legal entity.

SLO: If we get the ACH/wire details + final billing name/address by end of day 2026-09-16, we can reissue the invoices and send reissued invoice PDFs within 7 business days.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: clearwater_w9.pdf
